appName.message: SideAI: AI Sidebar For ChatGPT - Free Access

storeDesc.message:
ChatGPT Sidebar by SideAI brings ChatGPT into your browser sidebar so you can read, write, summarize, research, translate, and ask questions without constantly switching tabs.

SideAI is the rebranded and upgraded version of Sidebar for ChatGPT. It keeps the fast, familiar ChatGPT sidebar experience users already know, and adds a cleaner interface, better page tools, smarter writing workflows, screenshot capture, Google Search insights, custom prompts, and more.

The core ChatGPT sidebar is free and unlimited inside SideAI. You can open the sidebar whenever you need it and use your own ChatGPT account without adding an API key. Optional SideAI premium plans unlock advanced extension features, but the main sidebar access remains free.

ChatGPT users often need help directly on the page they are reading. SideAI fits naturally into workflows where you want ChatGPT sidebar access, an AI sidebar on web pages, chat gpt free access through your own account, chatgpt gratis browsing help, or a Copilot-style browser assistant for writing, research, summaries, screenshots, and page questions. This describes real SideAI browsing workflows; SideAI is independent and does not claim to be OpenAI, ChatGPT, Microsoft, or Copilot.

🚀 Quick Overview

SideAI gives you a fast AI sidebar for Chrome and Chromium-based browsers. Open ChatGPT beside any webpage, select text to run quick AI actions, improve writing inside fields, summarize pages, capture screenshots, and use saved prompts directly from your browsing workflow.

Instead of copying content, opening a new tab, pasting into ChatGPT, waiting for a response, and returning to the original page, SideAI keeps ChatGPT available where you are already working.

Use SideAI for research, writing, studying, coding, shopping, email, documentation, forms, dashboards, product comparisons, support replies, and everyday browsing.

✨ Key Features

✅ Free ChatGPT Sidebar

Open ChatGPT in a clean browser sidebar from almost any page. The core sidebar is free and unlimited, so you can keep AI help available while browsing. Open SideAI from the extension icon, keyboard shortcut, or right-click menu.

🔐 No API Key Required

SideAI works with your own ChatGPT account and session. You do not need to create, paste, or manage an API key. ChatGPT access, model availability, message limits, and subscriptions are controlled by your own OpenAI account.

🖱️ AI Text Selection Menu

Highlight text on a webpage and open a smart AI menu instantly. Use quick actions such as Ask, Summarize, Explain, Translate, Rewrite, Continue Writing, Fix Spelling & Grammar, and more. This is useful when you want help with selected text without leaving the page.

📄 Page Assistant

Chat with the current webpage. Ask SideAI to summarize a long article, explain a section, extract key points, answer follow-up questions, or help you understand the page faster. It is useful for research, learning, reading documentation, comparing products, and reviewing long content.

✍️ AI Writing Assistant

Improve text directly inside emails, forms, messages, comments, documents, and other writing fields. SideAI can help rewrite, polish, shorten, expand, fix grammar, improve tone, or generate better wording while you stay in the same field.

Use AI beside Google Search results to research faster. SideAI can provide concise answers, structured summaries, and useful context while you search, reducing the need to open many tabs just to understand a topic.

📸 Screenshot Capture

Capture a selected area or the visible part of a page and send it to the assistant for help. Use screenshots for debugging, explaining UI issues, summarizing visual content, asking questions about charts, or sharing context that is easier to show than describe.

🧩 Custom Prompts Library

Create and manage your own prompt library. Reuse prompts from the sidebar, context menu, or selection menu so your most common workflows are always close. This is helpful for repeated tasks such as rewriting in a specific tone, summarizing in a format, generating replies, or applying your own instructions.

⚡ Quick Chat

Open SideAI quickly and ask a question about the current page or your current task. Quick Chat is designed to reduce friction and keep your focus on the work you are doing.

🎙️ Voice and Microphone Support

Use voice features through your ChatGPT session when available. SideAI helps guide microphone access in the sidebar so voice workflows are easier to start when you want hands-free interaction.

🛡️ Per-Site Controls

Choose where SideAI tools appear. You can disable the text selection menu or page assistant on specific websites when you want a cleaner experience or when a site should stay untouched.

🎛️ Customizable Actions

Organize your text menu actions around your workflow. Show, hide, reorder, or customize actions so SideAI feels focused instead of crowded.

💡 Common Use Cases

✅ Summarize long articles, blog posts, and documentation
✅ Explain selected text in simple terms
✅ Translate text while reading webpages
✅ Rewrite emails, replies, and form content
✅ Fix grammar and improve writing tone
✅ Ask questions about the current page
✅ Research faster with AI beside Google Search
✅ Capture screenshots and ask for explanations
✅ Create reusable custom prompts
✅ Get help with code snippets or technical content
✅ Draft social posts, support replies, and messages
✅ Compare information across pages
✅ Keep ChatGPT available while browsing

🧭 How SideAI Works

1. Install SideAI from the Chrome Web Store.
2. Open the sidebar from the extension icon, keyboard shortcut, or right-click menu.
3. Sign in with your own ChatGPT account if needed.
4. Browse normally and use SideAI when you want AI help.
5. Select text, open page tools, capture screenshots, or use custom prompts when useful.

SideAI does not replace your ChatGPT account. It gives you a faster browser interface for using ChatGPT and adds productivity tools around your browsing workflow.

🆓 Free Access Clarification

SideAI includes free and unlimited access to the core browser sidebar feature. This means you can open the SideAI sidebar and use it as your ChatGPT sidebar without buying a SideAI plan.

SideAI premium plans are for advanced extension features, such as expanded assistant actions, writing workflows, page assistant tools, custom prompts, customization controls, and productivity features.

Premium plans do not include ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro, OpenAI API credits, or paid OpenAI access. ChatGPT availability, models, response limits, subscriptions, and account settings are managed by OpenAI through your own ChatGPT account.

⭐ Why Choose SideAI?

SideAI is built to be fast, focused, and useful across real browsing workflows. It is not just a separate chat window. It adds AI where you already work: selected text, webpages, search results, writing fields, screenshots, and reusable prompt flows.

It is designed for people who want a practical ChatGPT Chrome extension, a free AI sidebar, a browser AI assistant, a web page summarizer, an AI writing assistant, and a faster way to use ChatGPT on any website.

The goal is simple: keep AI help close without interrupting your browsing.

🚀 What’s New in SideAI 6.0.0

✅ Rebranded from Sidebar for ChatGPT to SideAI
✅ Cleaner SideAI interface and updated branding
✅ Improved text selection menu with better quick actions
✅ Writing Assistant for fields, forms, emails, and messages
✅ Page Assistant for summarizing and asking about webpages
✅ Google Search AI insights for faster research
✅ Screenshot capture and upload workflow
✅ Custom prompts and customizable action menu improvements
✅ Better onboarding and update notice inside the sidepanel
✅ Live license activation support for premium plans
✅ Stability, compatibility, and performance improvements

🔒 Privacy and Permissions

SideAI uses browser permissions to provide features such as the sidebar, text selection menu, page assistant, screenshot capture, writing assistant, Google Search insights, microphone support, and optional site controls.

SideAI is designed to work when you activate a feature, such as opening the sidebar, selecting text, asking about a page, improving writing, or capturing a screenshot.

No API key is required. SideAI uses your own ChatGPT session for ChatGPT-based workflows.

🌐 Compatibility

SideAI works on Google Chrome and Chromium-based browsers that support modern Chrome extension features. For the best experience, use the latest stable version of Chrome.

📩 Support

If you need help with installation, compatibility, premium access, billing, licenses, or feature behavior, contact support at support@sideai.app.

⚠️ Disclaimer

SideAI is an independent browser extension and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OpenAI. ChatGPT is a trademark of OpenAI. References to ChatGPT describe compatibility with the user’s own ChatGPT account.

Free and unlimited access refers to SideAI’s core browser sidebar feature, not free access to paid ChatGPT plans, ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro, OpenAI API usage, or other paid OpenAI services.

🧭 More Browsing Workflows

Use SideAI when you are reading an article and want a fast summary before deciding whether to read the full page.

Use SideAI when you are writing an email and want ChatGPT help to make the message clearer, shorter, more professional, or easier to understand.

Use SideAI when you are researching on Google Search and want AI context beside the results instead of opening many tabs.

Use SideAI when you are comparing products, reviewing documentation, studying a topic, checking code snippets, or preparing a reply.

Use SideAI when selected text on a page needs a quick explanation, translation, rewrite, answer, or custom prompt.

Use SideAI when a screenshot explains the problem better than words and you want to send visual context to the assistant.

SideAI is designed for people who want ChatGPT available in the browser without turning every task into a copy-and-paste workflow.

📌 Practical Examples

A student can keep ChatGPT open beside a course page and ask SideAI to explain difficult paragraphs in simpler words.

A writer can select a sentence in a form, email, or document and ask SideAI to rewrite it with a clearer tone.

A developer can capture a UI issue, code snippet, chart, or error message and send that screenshot context to the assistant.

A researcher can use Google Search insights, page summaries, and follow-up questions to move from search results to understanding faster.

A support worker can draft replies, simplify technical wording, translate customer messages, and reuse saved prompts without leaving the active tab.

A daily browser user can keep the ChatGPT sidebar available for quick questions, summaries, translations, explanations, and writing help across many websites.
